column1: # Every image the docs and the site ship, and what makes it (release_docs.py R11).
# scripts/docs_shots.sh reads this file and remakes the images from the simulator;
# `scripts/docs_shots.sh --check` (and release_docs.py check) refuses an image with
# no row here, a row whose image or generator is missing, or a shot its script
# never takes.  Synthetic or open media only (docs/legal.md L13a, section 5).
#   image       path from the repo root
#   generator   a simulator script (tests/ui/...script) or a script that writes the image itself
#   shot        for a sim script: the name of its "shot NAME" line; "-" otherwise
#   scale       for a sim script: 1 (320x240) or 2 (640x480, nearest-neighbour); "-" otherwise
#   sim         the simulator build the script runs on (see scripts/validate.sh script_sim)
# Every row but the previews runs on build/sim-rel-video (--ipodui --ipodui-release
# --bcmfw-video --bcmfw-merged) and so shows the menus a release shows. The preview
# rows (docs/user/images/preview/: features not released yet, labelled so on the
# page) run on build/sim-rel-preview, the same release shape with that release's
# compiled-out features switched on: tests/ui/docs/preview_sim.sh builds it, and
# tests/ui/docs/make_preview_fixtures.sh makes the track preview-npinfo plays. The first-start notice shows the
# release's version: docs_shots.sh sets IPODUI_SIM_VERSION (simulator builds only) from
# scripts/version.sh, or from DOCS_SHOTS_VERSION when given.
